description: This file defines the HomeActivity class, an Android activity serving as the entry point for the Home experience on Android TV. It manages the hosting of a HomeFragment within its layout, ensuring proper synchronization during fragment transactions to support the Leanback UI components.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: An activity class that hosts the HomeFragment for the Android TV Home experience, handling fragment initialization and configuration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; it sets up the activity layout and initializes the HomeFragment if not already present.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and hosts the HomeFragment.
